title: The Mummy Returns
synopsis: Rick and Evelyn O’Connell battle a resurrected Imhotep while racing to stop the ancient Scorpion King’s army from rising. Johnson opens the film as the warrior Mathayus and returns as a monstrous Scorpion King in the finale.

title: Longshot
synopsis: A low-budget comedy produced by Lou Pearlman and packed with cameos from late-’90s pop acts. Johnson turns up briefly as a mugger.

title: The Scorpion King
synopsis: In this prequel spin-off to The Mummy films, the assassin Mathayus is hired to kill the sorceress who protects the tyrant Memnon. His first leading role paid a record $5.5 million.

title: The Rundown
synopsis: A bounty hunter who dreams of opening a restaurant takes one last job: bringing his boss’s son (Seann William Scott) home from a lawless mining town in the Amazon. Arnold Schwarzenegger’s cameo plays as a passing of the action torch.

title: Walking Tall
synopsis: A former Special Forces soldier comes home to find his town overrun by a casino owner’s drugs and violence. He becomes sheriff to clean it up, with a two-by-four in hand.

title: Be Cool
synopsis: In the sequel to Get Shorty, Chili Palmer (John Travolta) moves from movies into the music business. Johnson steals scenes as Elliot, a bodyguard desperate to become an actor.

title: Doom
synopsis: A squad of Marines is sent to a research base on Mars after an experiment unleashes creatures on the scientists. Johnson plays Sarge, the squad’s hard-line commander, in this adaptation of the video game.

title: Gridiron Gang
synopsis: Based on a true story, a counselor at a juvenile detention camp builds a football team to give young offenders discipline and a second chance.

title: Southland Tales
synopsis: Richard Kelly’s sprawling satire of a near-future Los Angeles, where an amnesiac action star tied to a powerful political family is pulled into a conspiracy. It premiered in competition at Cannes.

cast.role: Officer Roland Taverner / Private Ronald Taverner

title: Reno 911!: Miami
synopsis: The hapless Reno sheriff’s deputies end up policing Miami Beach during a police convention. Johnson makes a cameo as a federal agent.

title: The Game Plan
synopsis: A self-absorbed star quarterback discovers he has an eight-year-old daughter and has to learn to be a father in the middle of the season.

title: Get Smart
synopsis: Bumbling analyst Maxwell Smart (Steve Carell) gets his shot as a field agent alongside Agent 99 (Anne Hathaway). Johnson plays Agent 23, the spy agency’s star operative.

title: Race to Witch Mountain
synopsis: A Las Vegas cab driver finds two siblings with supernatural powers in his back seat and has to protect them from the government agents hunting them.

title: Planet 51
synopsis: An American astronaut lands on a planet he thinks is empty, only to find little green aliens living in a world that looks like 1950s suburbia, where he is the invader.

title: Tooth Fairy
synopsis: A minor-league hockey enforcer who tells a child the tooth fairy isn’t real is sentenced to serve as one, wings and all.

title: Why Did I Get Married Too?
wiki: Why Did I Get Married Too?
synopsis: Tyler Perry’s sequel follows four couples on a group getaway as their marriages start to crack. Johnson makes a brief cameo.

title: The Other Guys
synopsis: Two mismatched desk cops (Will Ferrell and Mark Wahlberg) get their chance when the precinct’s superstar detectives are suddenly out of the picture. Johnson and Samuel L. Jackson play those superstars.

title: You Again
synopsis: A young woman discovers her brother is marrying the girl who bullied her in high school. Johnson has a cameo as an air marshal.

title: Faster
synopsis: Just out of prison, a man sets out to kill everyone responsible for his brother’s murder, pursued by a veteran cop and a hitman. A lean, R-rated return to hard action.

title: Fast Five
synopsis: Dom Toretto’s crew plans one last heist in Rio de Janeiro against a corrupt businessman, while relentless federal agent Luke Hobbs closes in. Johnson’s arrival turned the series into a global heist franchise.

title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
synopsis: A teenager and his stepfather follow a coded signal to a hidden island straight out of Jules Verne, full of giant creatures and lost treasure.

title: Snitch
synopsis: Inspired by true events, a father makes a deal with prosecutors to go undercover against a drug cartel to cut his son’s prison sentence.

title: G.I. Joe: Retaliation
synopsis: After the Joes are framed and nearly wiped out, Roadblock leads the survivors against Cobra and an impostor in the White House.

title: Pain & Gain
synopsis: Based on a true story, three Miami bodybuilders kidnap a wealthy businessman in a get-rich scheme that spirals out of control. Johnson plays a born-again ex-convict in Michael Bay’s dark crime comedy.

title: Fast & Furious 6
synopsis: Hobbs recruits Dom’s crew to take down a team of mercenary drivers in Europe in exchange for pardons, and they discover Letty is alive and working for the other side.

title: Empire State
synopsis: Based on a real 1982 armored-car depot robbery in New York, two childhood friends pull off the heist and draw the attention of a determined detective.

title: Hercules
synopsis: Haunted by his past, the demigod leads a band of mercenaries hired to train an army in Thrace, where myth and politics collide.

title: Furious 7
synopsis: Deckard Shaw hunts Dom’s crew to avenge his brother, and the team takes on a global mission to recover a surveillance program called God’s Eye. The film is also the series’ farewell to Paul Walker.

title: San Andreas
synopsis: When the San Andreas Fault triggers a massive earthquake, a Los Angeles fire department rescue pilot crosses a shattered California to save his daughter.

title: Jem and the Holograms
synopsis: A small-town teenager becomes an online music sensation and is swept into the industry with her sisters. Johnson appears briefly as himself.

title: Central Intelligence
synopsis: A bullied high-school kid turned CIA agent pulls his old classmate, now an accountant (Kevin Hart), into a dangerous case. It launched his screen partnership with Hart.

title: Moana
synopsis: A chief’s daughter sails beyond the reef to restore the heart of the goddess Te Fiti, with the reluctant help of the shape-shifting demigod Maui. Johnson sings “You’re Welcome”.

title: The Fate of the Furious
synopsis: The cyberterrorist Cipher forces Dom to turn on his own crew, and Hobbs teams up with old enemy Deckard Shaw to bring him back.

title: Baywatch
synopsis: A devoted lifeguard and a cocky new recruit (Zac Efron) uncover a criminal plot that threatens their beach, in this comedy take on the TV series.

title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
synopsis: Four teenagers are pulled into a video game and become its adult avatars. Johnson plays the heroic archaeologist Bravestone, inhabited by a nervous, gangly gamer.

title: Rampage
synopsis: A primatologist races to save his gorilla friend, mutated to giant size by a genetic experiment, as other monsters tear through Chicago.

title: Skyscraper
synopsis: A former FBI hostage-rescue leader, now a security consultant, has to get into the world’s tallest building, set on fire by criminals, to save his family.

title: Fighting with My Family
synopsis: Based on the true story of WWE wrestler Paige and her wrestling family from Norwich, England. Johnson produced the film and appears as himself.

title: Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw
synopsis: Hobbs and Deckard Shaw are forced to team up against a cybernetically enhanced terrorist (Idris Elba) to stop a deadly virus.

title: Jumanji: The Next Level
synopsis: The friends go back into the game to rescue Spencer, but glitches put his grandfather into Bravestone. Johnson does a running impression of Danny DeVito.

title: Jungle Cruise
synopsis: In 1916 a wisecracking riverboat captain takes a scientist (Emily Blunt) and her brother up the Amazon in search of a tree with legendary healing powers.

title: Free Guy
synopsis: A bank teller discovers he is a background character in an open-world video game and decides to become its hero. Johnson lends a brief voice cameo.

title: Red Notice
synopsis: An FBI profiler is forced to team up with a rival art thief (Ryan Reynolds) to catch the world’s most wanted thief (Gal Gadot) in a hunt for Cleopatra’s jeweled eggs.

title: DC League of Super-Pets
synopsis: When the Justice League is captured, Superman’s dog Krypto has to lead a group of shelter animals with new superpowers to the rescue.

title: Black Adam
synopsis: Nearly 5,000 years after he was given the powers of the gods, Teth-Adam is freed from his tomb in Kahndaq and clashes with the Justice Society. A project he championed for more than a decade.

title: Fast X
synopsis: Dante Reyes, the son of the drug lord from Fast Five, sets out to destroy Dom’s family. Johnson returns as Hobbs in a mid-credits scene.

title: Red One
synopsis: When Santa Claus is kidnapped, the head of North Pole security teams up with a cynical bounty hunter (Chris Evans) to save Christmas.

title: Moana 2
synopsis: Three years after her first voyage, Moana answers a call from her ancestors and sets out to find a lost island, with Maui by her side again.

title: The Smashing Machine
synopsis: Benny Safdie’s A24 drama follows MMA champion Mark Kerr through fights, addiction and his relationship with Dawn Staples (Emily Blunt). Johnson’s transformation earned him a Golden Globe nomination for Best Actor – Drama.

title: Moana
synopsis: Disney’s live-action remake of the 2016 film, with Johnson playing the demigod Maui in person.

title: Jumanji: Open World
synopsis: The final chapter of the Jumanji series, reuniting Johnson, Jack Black, Kevin Hart and Karen Gillan with director Jake Kasdan. Johnson also produces.
